title: Security tools image lock
description: Locks immutable digests of the Docker images used by security scanning tools (gitleaks, semgrep) so CI and local hooks run the exact same engine versions.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema file.

//.description: JSONC comment key. Human-readable notes only; ignored by tooling.

image.description: Docker image reference pinned by an immutable sha256 digest (not a mutable tag).

pinnedIn.description: Files where this image is pinned, keyed by integration name (e.g. ci, lefthook, dx).
